task_message:
Case V06: segment the vascular soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 121x121x68 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is finished. The final mask (v2, 9.2 mL, single component) outlines the T2-hyperintense lobulated vascular soft-tissue tumor over its full extent (axial 16–51, coronal 43–70, sagittal 52–74), including its less intense periphery, after:

- Locating the lesion on axial/coronal/sagittal contact sheets.
- Seeding it with two positive points on the bright core (v1).
- Adding one positive point on the under-covered lateral, less intense rim/extension (v2, +1.8 mL).
- Verifying coverage against the bright signal in all three planes and at both ends.
- Rejecting all five automatic candidate proposals, which consisted of normal muscle, fat and subcutaneous tissue.

Confidence: medium (boundary is clear in most planes, with some uncertainty where the lesion's signal fades laterally).
